title: Sandbox network prompt reads 'Allow kiln to use sandbox network? $ httpbin.org:443' and hides which command asked
observed: kiln defect (UX). allowedDomains [example.com, proxy.golang.org, sum.golang.org]. curl to example.com ran (200). curl to httpbin.org opened 'Allow kiln to use sandbox network?' with '$ httpbin.org:443' (a shell-prompt glyph before a host), options Yes / Yes, and don't ask again for this / No, and tell kiln what to do instead. The curl command that triggered it was not visible above the prompt. Esc declined, which aborted the whole turn ('Command aborted', '■ Interrupted'), while the aborted bash block still said 'auto-approved · 8.7s'.
expected: Wording like 'Allow network access to httpbin.org:443 (from: curl -s … https://httpbin.org/get)?', no '$' glyph, and say what 'don't ask again' covers (this host, this session or saved). Do not label an aborted command 'auto-approved'.
